# CoreSphere AI

> Enterprise operations intelligence and knowledge ecosystem for United Bank for Africa (UBA) Customer Fulfillment Group — an AI-powered operations coach, knowledge governance, learning, and workforce intelligence platform.

CoreSphere AI is a restricted internal banking operations platform. Most surfaces require authenticated UBA enterprise access.

## Pages

- [Sign in](/login): Sign in to CoreSphere AI with UBA enterprise credentials.

## Optional

- [Knowledge Hub](/knowledge-hub): Operational SOPs, procedures and training (authenticated).
